outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a standalone landscape background illustration for the Credits & licenses screen of Fall, a medieval Spanish-card game. Target 16:9, 2048 x 1152. No UI, letters, lettering, readable text, logos, watermarks, card designs or banners.
Reference image 1 (Card Hall) is the palette and architecture anchor: cool slate stone, believable oak, restrained aged brass, natural window light. Reference image 2 (archive) is the matte painted material reference, not a layout to copy.
Scene: an original quiet medieval illuminator's atelier, a room where the game's makers might record their work. One weathered oak writing desk sits low on the left with an open blank parchment ledger, a feather quill in a dark inkwell, a small red wax seal and rolled parchment. A modest shelf of hand-bound books and a single unlit brass candleholder occupy the right edge. A tall narrow stone window at the far left admits gentle cool morning daylight. Soft local warm reflected oak/parchment color, no scene-wide amber or burgundy wash. No characters needed.
Composition is designed for live center-aligned scrolling credits: the middle 55–60% of the image is broad, quiet mid-dark slate wall and soft atmospheric depth, with very low-contrast material detail. Keep the central region dark enough for ivory live type without making it a flat black vertical rectangle. Place the telling props around the lower left and outer right, never behind the main reading column. Show airy breathing room around architecture, soft shadow gradients and subtle reflected light. The center should feel like a naturally quiet room, not an empty UI panel painted onto scenery.
Style: polished painterly game environment with broad matte value groups, grounded perspective, selective detail on desk and books, aged materials. Same world and color balance as Card Hall. Avoid ornate fantasy machinery, glowing magic, glossy bevels, extreme black vignettes, cinematic bloom, dust clouds, dramatic orange candles or excessively dense books. Keep the visual focus on authorship and craftsmanship through the ledger/quill props.
This is a new production background, not a mockup or crop of a mockup.
outputs.notes: Generated 2026-11-18 with the OpenAI built-in ImageGen tool; model identifier not exposed. Standalone landscape artwork, not extracted from a UI mockup. Runtime landscape export: ../../../src/assets/credits/atelier-landscape.webp. PNG output exported to WebP quality 83, effort 6, preserving the original dimensions.
